deviations.label: POINT (1 2) trailing
deviations.why: betterknown stops after one geometry; mbmap/data reads geometries to the end and refuses other text

deviations.label: POINT (1a 2)
deviations.why: betterknown's parseFloat takes a number's prefix; mbmap/data refuses the field

deviations.label: POINT (1 2 3)
deviations.why: betterknown refuses Z without a tag; mbmap/data takes 2 to 4 ordinates when untagged, as GDAL's older WKT writes them

deviations.label: <http://www.opengis.net/def/crs/epsg/0/4326>POINT (1 2)
deviations.why: betterknown takes an OGC CRS URI prefix; mbmap/data does not

deviations.label: byte order 2
deviations.why: wkx reads any byte but 0 as little-endian

deviations.label: MultiPoint of a LineString
deviations.why: wkx takes members of any type

deviations.label: trailing bytes
deviations.why: wkx ignores bytes after the geometry; mbmap/data reads geometries to the end

deviations.label: the crs option leaves the .prj parser unloaded
deviations.why: a crs given in place of the .prj needs no WKT parser

deviations.label: layers listed
deviations.why: the layers of an archive are its .shp files outside __MACOSX, in archive order

deviations.label: an encrypted entry
deviations.why: refused by mbmap/data's zip reader (shpjs not asked)

deviations.label: compression method 12
deviations.why: refused by mbmap/data's zip reader (shpjs not asked)

deviations.label: an entry larger than the cap
deviations.why: refused by mbmap/data's zip reader (shpjs not asked)

deviations.label: an entry that inflates past its size
deviations.why: refused by mbmap/data's zip reader (shpjs not asked)

deviations.label: no shapefile
deviations.why: refused by mbmap/data's zip reader (shpjs not asked)

deviations.label: a missing layer
deviations.why: refused by mbmap/data's zip reader (shpjs not asked)

deviations.label: not an archive
deviations.why: refused by mbmap/data's zip reader (shpjs not asked)

deviations.label: a cap on inflated bytes
deviations.why: readZip's `bytes` limit holds across reads

deviations.label: a hole inside one outer ring and another's box
deviations.why: mbmap/data gives a hole to the smallest outer ring that contains it (point in ring); shpjs compares bounding boxes only

deviations.label: MultiPatch
deviations.why: MultiPatch shapes are refused

deviations.label: a record past the end
deviations.why: shpjs stops at a record cut short; mbmap/data refuses the file

deviations.label: a logical field of ?
deviations.why: a logical that is neither true nor false is null; shpjs makes it false

deviations.label: objects listed
deviations.why: a topology's objects are its layers, in order

deviations.label: a GeoJSON object
deviations.why: only a Topology is read (topojson-client reads any object with arcs and objects)

deviations.label: 4326 alone leaves proj.wasm unloaded
deviations.why: only rows in another CRS load the coordinate system module

deviations.label: SRID 9999
deviations.why: SRIDs proj.wasm does not know are refused
